To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) perceived service quality is a key driver of trust and commitment; (2) customer bonding techniques are a key driver of commitment but not trust; and (3) the relationship between trust and commitment is not a linear one.

perceived quality of the services and the bonding techniques used by a service provider influence trust in the service provider, which in turn leads to the commitment of the customer towards the service provider.

1) perceived quality of service has a positive impact on trust, 2) perceived quality of services has a positive impact commitment, 3) customer bonding has a positive impact trust, 4) customer bonding has positive impact on commitment, and 5) customer bonding has an indirect positive impact on commitment through trust.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of the service provider's customer bonding techniques on the development of trust and commitment, and how these, in turn, affect customer retention.
the role that perceived quality and bonding play in building trust and commitment in the business-to-business context.
the role of trust and commitment on customer retention in B2B services and how these are influenced by the perceived quality of service and bonding techniques.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the perceived quality of service is the most important antecedent of trust and commitment.
trust and commitment are important in B2B services.
trust and commitment are two important antecedents of customer retention and that the perceived quality of service and the customer bond techniques are the most important antecedents in this context.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
perceived service quality is a key antecedent of trust, which in turn influences commitment, which is a major antecedent of customer retention.
we have found that the quality of the service has a significant positive effect on trust.
we found a significant relationship between the perceived quality of service and the level of trust that the customer had towards the service provider.
The main takeaway from our work is that
customer retention is an important aspect in B2B markets.
customer retention is influenced by trust, which is, in turn, influenced by the perceived quality of services and customer bonding techniques.
customer trust is a key factor in the retention of customers in the business-to-business ( B2B ) service industry.
